tools.description: One status line for the simulated bench: modules by state, rails, fault, the taint latch and stored handles. Written by the host from its own state; it returns no module content. Call it first.
tools.name: bench_status
tools.title: Bench status

tools.description: Every enrolled module: id, hub port, the owner's label, state, the enrolled hazard-class ceiling and whether it may transmit. From the owner's enrollment and the supervisor's own state; it returns no module content.
tools.name: inventory
tools.title: Inventory

tools.description: One module's enrollment and its manifest pages, checked against the digest pinned at enrollment. The pages are the module's own text: they are returned fenced as untrusted data, stored behind a handle, and reported to the taint latch.
tools.name: describe
tools.title: Describe a module

tools.description: Asks a module for a config value or a live reading (live readings are keys 256 and up), 1 to 64 times. Returns a summary of what the module claims, which is device-reported and not measured, and a handle to the samples. Reported to the taint latch.

key.description: The config key; live readings are 256 and up.

tools.name: read
tools.title: Read a module value

tools.description: Without a handle: lists this session's handles. With a handle: its summary, and for a read, statistics over samples from..to. Never returns raw samples.

from.description: First sample, for a read handle.

handle.description: A handle from an earlier result.

to.description: One past the last sample, for a read handle.

tools.name: session_query
tools.title: Query the session store
